description: This file declares utility functions related to network interfaces, MAC address and IP address generation, and interface existence checks, specifically for the Android Cuttlefish project.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaceExists
methods.description: Checks if a network interface with the specified name exists.

methods.name: TapInterfacesInUse
methods.description: Returns a set of TAP interface names that currently have open file descriptors (only on Linux).

methods.name: GenerateCorrespondingIpv6ForMac
methods.description: Generates an IPv6 address based on a given MAC address.

methods.name: GenerateMobileMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a MAC address for a mobile device instance based on an index.

methods.name: GenerateEthMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates an Ethernet MAC address for a specific instance.

methods.name: GenerateWifiMacForInstance
methods.description: Generates a WiFi MAC address for a specific instance.

methods.name: MacAddressToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to its string representation.

methods.name: Ipv6ToString
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address byte array to its string representation.
